contract.claim: Complete ordinary managed CPU Graph versus Direct cycles for official GLM Flash FP8 and DeepSeek Flash FP4/FP8 programs; same original math, one private vendor thread, resident inputs, conversions, native allocations and completion boundaries. No raw Provider or mathematical SOTA claim.

configuration.mathematics: Same source-qualified TorchAO/ATen codecs, original A8 and full FP8/FP4 program in both arms; existing mature routing and activations.
configuration.role: Same immutable official fragment source and product SDK; ordinary default CPU Context, managed native temporary memory, OMP/MKL=1. Direct prepared complete DAG compared with Graph planning/reuse. Each measured call visits all changed slots once.

charged_phases: All 2 complete ordinary blocking fragments per call: native math, finite/ID checks, original quantization, necessary conversion/copies, managed temporary Tensors, terminal waits and completion destruction; retained slot buffer ownership identical.

input.distribution: Original D5 independently verified format-valid synthetic encoded weights and changed activation slots; no downloaded full model weights.

material_contribution.denominator: One complete cycle of 2 resident changed-input fragments through final completion settlement
material_contribution.derivation: Actual fixed model-shaped consumer; not model/token throughput or invented production frequency.

ownership_topology.peer: Independent Direct Context, constants and retained intermediate/output buffers for the same complete DAG. Every accepted completion is settled and destroyed within the call; native temporary Tensors are released.
